heading: Dispatches from the South
intro:
To forget. To love and to suffer. To find out and, what's even more, to understand! It is so comforting just knowing that I am not the first, nor the last, to be asking the eternal questions, nor the last one to be left without an answer.

This archaic binding of ink and paper seems to be the road to the answer. Oh well, it all starts with the question anyway, right? For the question is like a blank page, which, to a practitioner of the art of life, is an opportunity. To see anew.

Are you willing to forget it all, and believe you will find a way to remember? Do you trust that the person you become will find out about the person you ceased to be?
